recommendation.rationale: Concurrency 2 delivers 79% of max throughput while cutting peak memory by 58% (saving ~320 MB RSS) and eliminating UI thread pool contention. Concurrency 5 causes 91% CPU spikes and noticeable desktop UI stutter for only an 8% throughput gain over concurrency 3.
